subsections.text: BS Computer Science graduate from the University of the Philippines Diliman with a strong track record of architecting full-stack web and mobile applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL databases. Experienced in building dynamic QR-based tools, user dashboards, real-time API integrations, and scalable relational database schemas while delivering clean, maintainable code. Proven ability to rapidly master new technologies on-demand, lead technical workflows in agile teams, and translate product requirements into intuitive user interfaces.

subsections.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern ( UP FLCD éLaan )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Client-based Internship, Agile, GitHub, SvelteKit, Supabase, PostgreSQL
items: Initiated and executed a freelance-style internship with a university department to digitize its booking workflow.
Led the agile development process, facilitating sprint planning, task allocation, and regular client check-ins.
Architected and implemented the core backend system, starting from a normalized PostgreSQL relational database schema.
Developed dynamic, multi-step multi-role reservation forms using server actions, implementing strict server-side validation to ensure clean data entry before database insertion.
Implemented role-based booking flows and data handling to support multiple user types and administrative dashboards.
Rapidly learned and applied Svelte, SvelteKit, and PostgreSQL to deliver a production-ready system within tight timelines.

subsections.title: QR-based Class Attendance Software ( RollCall )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Full-Stack Mobile App, Agile Development, GitHub, Supabase, Ionic React, PostgreSQL
items: Developed a full-stack application that automates classroom attendance using QR code scanning and dynamic session validation.
Implemented backend services using Supabase and PostgreSQL to manage auth, real-time attendance records, and course data.
Designed normalized relational database schemas and access rules to guarantee data integrity and prevent duplicate logs.
Integrated frontend Ionic React components with backend services to deliver real-time attendance validation feedback.
Worked in an agile environment with weekly sprints, client standups, and iterative UX improvements based on user feedback.

subsections.title: Virtual Workspace with AI Transcription ( SyncSpace )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 4 | Technical Lead, Next.js, TypeScript, React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Vercel, Railway, GitHub
items: Conceptualized, led, and co-developed a virtualized spatial office platform integrated with automated AI meeting transcriptions.
Stepped up as acting technical lead, directing sprint goals, technical documentation, and cross-functional task alignment.
Architected the system's ERD and implemented the Supabase backend infrastructure, handling relational database design, user authentication, and Google OAuth integration.
Developed custom Supabase backend functions and modular REST endpoint logic to bridge frontend UI states with real-time data.
Owned the multi-platform deployment topology, configuring CI/CD pipelines on Vercel for the frontend and orchestrating independent backend microservices on Railway.

subsections.title: Web Wrapper with Widgets for iOS & CarPlay ( LiveLyrics )
subsections.subtitle: Sole Developer | React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Objective-C, WidgetKit, REST APIs, GitHub
items: Directed AI-assisted development tools to rapidly prototype, debug, and ship an end-to-end music application within 2 weeks.
Architected an web wrapper app delivering real-time synced lyrics across iOS Home Screen, Lock Screen, and CarPlay widgets.
Orchestrated React Native to WidgetKit IPC using Swift and Objective-C bridges to shared UserDefaults data structures.
Designed real-time DOM lyrics scraping, LRC parsing algorithms, and background playback pipelines.
Managed Expo prebuild workflows, target entitlement capabilities, and physical iOS deployment documentation.

items.Frontend Development: Next.js, React (Ionic React, React Native), Svelte, SvelteKit, HTML5, CSS3
items.Backend & Databases: Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Playwright, Authentication, REST & RPC API Integration
items.Cloud & Infrastructure: Vercel, Railway, Git, GitHub, VS Code, Figma, Agile Methodology, Software Documentation, Debugging
